entries.title: World Bank Energy & Mining Indicators (World Development Indicators)
entries.description: Cross-country energy indicators — electricity access, consumption, renewable share, and energy imports — compiled by the World Bank as part of its World Development Indicators database.
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). IEA and IRENA — the other obvious international energy-statistics bodies — both returned bot-challenge pages (Cloudflare / Azure WAF) on direct fetch this session, the same class of block tracked for BLS/SEC in almanac-template#2. Worth a headless-verified follow-up entry once that fix lands, rather than skipping them. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.
